decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint fits the firm's core pipe and valve metalwork, and it moved from a mention to its own page, which suggests steady demand for a low-cost standard part.
Powder-coated public waste bins use the firm's existing sheet-metal and coating capabilities and sell steadily to municipalities, so keeping them costs little.
The bin with ashtray is a small variant of the waste bin and shares its production, so it is cheap to keep despite falling demand from smokers.
The outdoor ashtrays complete the street furniture range on the same production lines, though they are the most exposed of the group to declining smoking and could be cut if sales stay weak.
